snippet.title: Shinsengumi Gunrou Den Trailer
snippet.description:
幕末の日本で活躍した、新選組の一番隊隊長・沖田総司となり、倒幕派志士たちと戦う爽快剣撃アクション！敵の攻撃を見切り、隙をついて連続コンボを繰り出す戦闘シーンに注目！
It was an active recruitment in Japan at the end of the Edo era, becoming the first commander of the Shinsengumi, Shoji Okita, a refreshing sword attack action fighting the batting scholars! Pay close attention to the battle scenes that break off enemy attacks and draw out continuous combos with gaps!

Extracted from a Dengeki demo disk. IGN had some of this footage but it was a recording of a screen so a proper upload was needed. This game was released in the EU under the name "Code of the Samurai"
